limitations: No code is evaluated and no full methods are copied.
Only numeric/string/boolean/null literals are resolved; arithmetic and symbols remain pending.
Item constructor IDs may be offsets and are not asserted to be final legacy IDs.
Recipe calls inside loops/conditionals are not expanded and are not final recipe counts.
Inherited constructor behavior, configuration gates, conflicts and override order require semantic review.
Generation literals are candidate evidence, not inferred final spawn rates.
